data.name: RESET ARENA
data.detailed_description:
Reset Arena is a fast, brutal 1v1 duel fought entirely in cyberpunk ASCII text.

No sprites. No polygons. Just glowing terminal glyphs, three hits and the fight is over. You win or you get RESET! In Reset Arena every hit counts, so sharpen your blade, load up on skill shots and be sure you know just when to use your shield. 21 dynamic arena maps are where you must win and win and win again to climb to the top of the leader board.


The Duel

Reset Arena strips a fighting game down to its core: Attack, Block, and Dash, each running on its own independent cooldown. There's no combo string to memorize and no health bar to whittle down — just three hearts, a live read of your opponent's rhythm, and a single mistake separates you from victory or a reset.

Then there's the skill shots. A selection from a pool of 8 distinct projectile types are dropped in to every arena, every match — a homing dart you can juke with a well-timed dash, a hook that drags your opponent toward you, a shot that reverses their controls, one that kills their screen entirely. Toggle in and out of using them on the fly with a simple Q/E system, and stack the mind games on top of the melee.

No two arenas play the same. Rotating firewalls, proximity mines, teleporter pairs, moving walls — every map brings its own hazards into the fight, and the arena is as much your opponent as the person across from you.

Play Your Way

  • Online ranked matches — climb the leaderboard against real opponents

  • Local 1v1 — same screen, same keyboard, zero mercy - we are not responsible if you punch your sibling in the nose

  • Private matches — Need to practice without risking your win streak grab a friend, or enemy and share your private match code with them.

There's More Here Than a Duel

Reset Arena isn't only a fighting game. Somewhere in the game's own command console, secrets are waiting for players curious enough to go looking. What you'll find in there is yours to discover.

Key Features

  • Pure text-rendered combat — a genuinely distinct visual style.

  • 8 skill shot types with real tactical depth — homing, reflection, area denial, and more, each counterable in its own way

  • 20+ unique arenas, each with its own hazard layout

  • Independent-cooldown combat — no combos, no health bars, just three hearts and a clean read on your opponent

  • Online ranked ladder with a live leaderboard

  • Local 1v1 for couch play

  • Hidden content waiting to be found by players willing to dig into the archives of the command console

Built solo by Goldfinch_Arche of Goldfinch Games, a husband and father working to fulfill a life long dream of developing a game people love to play.

data.short_description: Reset Arena is a fast, text-rendered 1v1 duel game. Attack, block and dash on independent cooldowns, toggle between skill shots like homing darts and ensnaring hooks and outread your opponent across 20+ arenas full of shifting hazards and dynamic environments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz(Intel Core i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with DirectX 11 support (integrated graphics, e.g. Intel HD 4000-class, is sufficient)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio (DirectSound compatible)
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & mouse only at launch. Online matchmaking requires an internet connection; local duel modes do not.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz+ (Intel Core i5 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated or modern integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio (DirectSound compatible)
  • VR Support: Not Supported

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 3.3+ support (integrated is fine)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA/PulseAudio compatible integrated audio
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & mouse only at launch. AppImage build; no additional dependencies expected.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04+ / SteamOS 3.5+
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated or modern integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA/PulseAudio compatible integrated audio
  • VR Support: Not Supported
